crossRefs.note: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
When they had arrived, and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with…
When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported…
All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done…
For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the…
in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to…
Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?
But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of…
Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain,
for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.
But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the…
Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

translations.web: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.
translations.bsb: Paul greeted them and recounted one by one the things that God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.
translations.kjv: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
translations.asv: And when he had saluted them, he rehearsed one by one the things which God had wrought among the Gentiles through his ministry.
